◆ cycles

DynamicArray<ArticulatedCycleJointParams> superdex::robotics::BotPrefab::cycles

Cycle-closing joints for closed-loop mechanisms (e.g.

four-bar linkages, parallel grippers). Each entry becomes one superdex::ArticulatedActorParams::cycles entry at instantiation time. Link references (superdex::ArticulatedCycleJointParams::parentLink / superdex::ArticulatedCycleJointParams::childLink) are int indices into links.
